name: tpl-existence-3-goal
task: Get into the locked room. Pick up the ball.

value.feedback: CHANGES REQUIRED: The task says 'Get into the locked room. Pick up the ball.' The clauses cover both goals, but the order is missing. 'Pick up the ball' is a commanded step after 'get into the locked room', so the task requires a hard Precedence(target_room_entered, target_picked_up). Keep both hard Existence clauses and add that Precedence. Without it, the machine accepts picking up the ball before entering the room, which the task does not allow. Also note that the Existence on target_room_entered is hard and needed, since no other clause forces it.

NO CHANGES NEEDED: The task commands two separate events, entering the locked room and picking up the ball, and each has a hard Existence clause. The environment already forces target_picked_up after target_room_entered, so no order clause is needed, and no clause is redundant.

texts: Get into the locked room, so that target_room_entered becomes true at least once.
Pick up the ball (the mission target), so that target_picked_up becomes true at least once.
